rules: Eligibility is evidence intake only, never renderer fidelity, historical authentication, whole-case certification or automatic ledger verification.

An independent original must bind exact request conditions, selected source record and engine component; identify observed original OS and Kaleidoscope 2.3.1 installation; record producer, capture time and method.
Validate image bytes, SHA-256, lossless PNG structure and exact request dimensions. Resolve artifact paths inside the intake root, including symlinks; reject files or decoded images over 40 MiB.
Reject known self-regression or qualitative image bytes presented as independent originals, including full frames; known-byte screening is not authentication of unknown images.
Hash every provenance artifact. Require capture-log and environment-manifest; the environment manifest must exactly join source, engineComponent and observed fields.

Require one accepted independent reviewer, valid timestamp, notes, exact request digest, entire capture digest, target IDs and equal capture/review scope; missing checks stay partial and rejected/stale decisions never pass.
All request targets stay unresolved in reports; scoped observations never satisfy a whole request. Non-independent evidence remains separately classified.

Omitted scope means full v1; no scoped relaxation applies. Require named/versioned/hashed font, original ordered resource providers, base chain and patch stack. Empty base/patch arrays need reasons; unknowns are incomplete.

Require actual integer procedureId/variant/hilite/value, matching enabled/window-active flags, recorded default mechanism/invocation, positive font size/style, palette depth/hash/description and capture method.
Require review checks originalEnvironment, sourceAndBaseIdentity, engineAndPatchStack, conditionsAndTransform, imageAndArtifacts, independentOfScriptoscope.

Only exact publicFaceScope admission applies: complete 80x20 empty face, 160x80 full port image, retained context, scale1, origin0, white opaque composited background. Preserve the exact versioned scope and exclusions.

Require observed NewControl/Draw1Control, procedure0/variant0/value0, exact state/Rect/title and no default API invocation. Private default state must remain explicitly unknown, distinct from requested defaultRing false.

Allow only explicit null plus reason for font, patchStack, baseChain, resourceSearchOrder, selectedProvider, resourceCache and privateDefaultState. Known values still undergo their normal identity checks.

Require configured archive/fork identity separate from actual provider, indexed palette depth/hash, exact external producer build identities, producer table/encoding/color realization/timing, and observed producer version or explicit unknown reason.

Require full-frame image/hash/bounds and exact no-resampling crop transform. Require unique configured-scheme/public-invocation/pixel-conditions/indexed-palette/producer-identities/producer-table/full-frame artifact roles with exact observed metadata/hash joins.

Require review checks originalEnvironment, installationAndConfiguredSource, publicInvocation, recordedPixelConditions, conditionsAndTransform, imageAndArtifacts, independentOfScriptoscope, scopeAndLimits. Associated geometry/fill IDs remain unverified; all requested requirements remain unresolved.

Only Windows95 and System7 normal requests qualify; hilite0, enabled, active window. Claim recorded composited normal pixels only, not alpha, font independence, automatic size, other states, default rings or private selection.

Only Windows95 and System7 pressed/inactive requests qualify; require HiliteControl10/enabled or HiliteControl255/disabled in an active window. Exclude physical mouse gesture and inactive-window claims.

Requests declaring patternOriginState require observed API availability and evidence; available requires integer offset pair, unavailable forbids an invented offset. Require independent patternOriginState review.

Nonzero origin requires reviewed-direct-drawing invocation, nonzero-origin justification and source reference. Exact direct-origin-invocation artifact joins controlDefinition, directOriginEvidence and patternOriginState; independent directOriginInvocation review is required.
Only crayon-os.normal qualifies: empty80x20 at20,20, origin0, full160x80 effective clip, normal hilite0/enabled/active and no default API. Preserve all v1/v2 scopes unchanged.

For this scope only, patternOriginState must be explicit null with a nonempty unknown reason. Port origin0 does not establish original pattern phase or API availability. The full request still requires patternOrigin evidence.
Claim only complete conditioned composited-face output. Exclude original pattern phase, general body paint, pattern mask and private pattern provider; all broad request targets stay unresolved.
Only apple-lisa.normal qualifies: empty80x20 at20,20, origin0, full160x80 effective clip, normal hilite0/enabled/active, no default API. Existing v1/v2/v3 scopes remain unchanged.

Claim only the complete conditioned composited face. No original provider/cache, pattern phase, alpha/mask or general body-paint claim. This scope does not alter full-request requirements or prior capture eligibility.

Only the finite 18-source fixed empty-push campaign IDs newly admitted by publicFaceScope v5 qualify; existing v1/v2/v3/v4 scopes and requests remain unchanged. The 54 source/state combinations are planned observations, not evidence of captures or fidelity.

Require NewControl(proc0)/Draw1Control and HiliteControl0 normal/enabled,10 logical highlight/enabled, or255 disabled, always value0/variant0/active window, empty80x20 at20,20, origin0, full160x80 effective clip and no default API. Physical gestures and inactive-window behavior are excluded.

Require explicit null patternOriginState with a nonempty unknown reason. Neither port origin0 nor matching pixels establishes original pattern phase or API availability. Full-request pattern-origin requirements remain strict.

Claim only the complete conditioned white-composited face. Original provider/cache/search order, pattern phase/mask/general body paint, font independence, automatic sizing, rings, shifted placement and all broad request targets remain unresolved.

maintenance.rule: Changes to eligibility behavior or normative requirements require review of affected policy sections and version/rule updates. Pure refactors with unchanged semantics require explicit no-policy-impact review; never silently change a decision rule.
transitiveDependencies: contract.mjs: readContract, publicFaceScope, requiredReviewChecks, assessCapture, assessCorpus, inside, knownImages, digest/reviewDigest
png.mjs: inspectPNG and imported zlib decoding semantics
Source registry selection identity, request baseline dependencies and target requirement definitions
Artifact/path/image checks, contamination inventory discovery, scope selection, reviewer and report-status rules
maintenance.provenanceOnly: Global authority document bytes/version, catalog version, ledger inventoryVersion and registry-wide review/schema metadata do not alter an individual request obligation. Normative changes must enter the applicable sections or actual request/target/scope/source/engine bindings.
